Hayes Philip Caldwell Professor of Business Administration, Emeritus Philip Caldwell Professor of Business Administration, Emeritus Read more Robert Hayes is the Philip Caldwell Professor of Business Administration, Emeritus, at the Harvard Business School. Prior to his appointment to the Harvard Faculty in 1966, he worked for I.B.M. and McKinsey & Company. He received his Ph.D. degree in 1966 from Stanford University.
